hooks.text: A city-killer asteroid passed halfway between Earth and the Moon.
Did you know a city-killer asteroid snuck past the Moon?
Astronomers barely caught an asteroid that nearly hit Earth.

title: The asteroid that snuck past Earth
description: Discover how astronomers caught a city-killer asteroid just days before its shockingly close pass between Earth and the Moon in 2023.
